CustomField.description: The name of the survey that was sent. Populated by Typeform using URL parameters that are set on the form, embedded in the email template sent by the flow (Case_AccountSupport_SendSurveyResponseEmail OR CustomerSuccess_CoreOnboarding_SendSurveyResponseEmail) Used by Flow to populate beginning of the Survey Response Name. Used by Page Layout to check if the survey should show CSAT or NPS fields. Read Only to all but Admin (via Profile) and Typeform Integration User (via permission set)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name of the survey sent to the respondent
CustomField.label: Survey Name
